description: Automatically test websites from multiple accessibility perspectives.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time

notes.note: Accessibility audits are expensive, slow, and skipped — 24 automated checks each shipped with a copy-paste fix makes a11y as routine as spellcheck. The CI integration ($49/mo/repo, fail builds on regressions) is the wedge that turns a nice tool into infrastructure. Axe-core exists, but the fix-generation loop is the differentiator.
Run all 24 checks scores the sample page; zero errors.
Normalized score schema: iteration-2 worker used thesis/magic_moment/demo_legibility/value_prop/ceiling; mapped to startup/originality/quality/usefulness/tech respectively.

iteration_notes.change: Deploy-gate verdict panel in the score card (DEPLOY BLOCKED / CLEAR TO SHIP); Copy-all-fixes button on results
